prioritized_defects.description: The diagram models the mediator as receiving the initiation request, but the required trigger path is incomplete because the Web Server action is not explicitly tied to the exceptional load condition that causes the request.
prioritized_defects.evidence: R99 and R103 require that the Web Server send an initialization request to the Mediator when the primary CDN realizes it cannot handle part of the workload under exceptional circumstances; the diagram has a decision and a send/receive pair, but the send action is not explicitly constrained by the full trigger conditions beyond a generic decision label.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Annotate the send path so the trigger condition is explicitly represented on the decision/guard or connected action, preserving the required exceptional-load semantics.

final_recommendation: Prioritize the high-severity requirement coverage defects first, then address the medium-severity semantic defect.
